officialCad.note: One rigid canonical transform applied to native assembled front/rear shells and two lightpipes. Displaced copies omitted. Eight native comb exit planes at raw Z=9.2 are partitioned into independent LED materials, without moving, duplicating or changing any native triangle. Original shells and lightpipes have no scaling, cuts or independent alignment. Buttons and PCB are reconstructed separately.

controls.channelMapping: Native raised digits prove rawX20.2=CH0, increasing by6.8 mm through rawX67.8=CH7. With chosen +Y transform CH0 is lower; press-1/rgb-1=CH0 and press-8/rgb-8=CH7. RGB ids identify physical location, not U1–U9 serial chain order.
